task_objective: Implement Task 4 of the Syncthing event cursor subscription plan: split watch caps and surface a truthful terminal upload status.
tests_added: Backend post-game incomplete-upload terminal reason publishes the distinct status.
Post-game polling survives the previous 120-second cap and stops at its own ceiling with the distinct status.
post_game_upload_incomplete maps to syncthing_upload_incomplete while genuine API unavailability remains mapped separately.
red_proof: The focused suite first failed with 3 failures: the new backend reason published syncthing_unavailable, the post-game watch stopped at the old cap, and the reason mapper returned null.
design_decisions: Pre-game keeps its 120-second quiescence cap unchanged.

Post-game uses a 300-second frontend ceiling, below the backend 900-second absolute ceiling. The frontend ceiling bounds the no-evidence awaiting_fresh_completion state, where no outstanding-need value exists for the backend stall detector to evaluate.

syncthing_upload_incomplete is an auto-hiding amber outcome rather than an error: the local backup succeeded, and waiting or restoring peer connectivity is not an actionable plugin configuration repair. It is therefore intentionally excluded from ACTIONABLE_UNAVAILABLE_REASONS.
results: Focused Task 4 Vitest command passed: 2 files, 75 tests. Full gates passed: 335 Vitest tests, TypeScript typecheck, Rollup build, Ruff check/format, ty check, module-size budget, and 917 pytest tests at 89.53% coverage.
